gate_rule: Any failed required item with severity critical or high vetoes the main ranking until remediated under a new preregistration version.

items.test: Every evidence available_at is <= case as_of; future documents are inaccessible and decoy future data is rejected.
Candidate prompts, outputs and identities were inaccessible to authors, oracle builders and exclusion reviewers before locks.
Near-duplicate detection and provenance review find no cross-family duplicates; all variants remain clustered within one family.
Canonical leaf diff proves each variant changes only its registered axis, with expected invariants unchanged.
Requested ID, response ID, provider snapshot and fallback logs match the sealed identity manifest for every run.
Prompt, tools, budgets, retries, ordering and environment hashes match across candidates within each declared resource view.
Independent recomputation matches deterministic oracle and frozen grader on positive, negative and boundary fixtures.
Open-output judges are blind, order-randomized, candidate-independent, calibrated by candidate slice, and accompanied by limitations.
Every exclusion uses a registered code, predates unblinding, has independent evidence, applies symmetrically to the whole family, and is not rank-conditioned.
CSR, pass^3, abstention, L3/L4, cost, latency, family-cluster confidence intervals and Holm corrections independently reproduce.
Business-difference, confidence, multiplicity, bootstrap-top, leave-one-family-out, pass^3 and zero-L4 gates all pass before a leader claim.
Only Gold contributes to the main ranking; Silver appears only in diagnostic output and cannot alter weights, exclusions or leader.
Exactly 30 families x 3 variants x 3 models x 3 repeats are present once, including excluded rows, with sealed row hashes.
All preregistration, policy, schema, grader, fixtures and tests match the published bundle hash; no post-freeze mutation is silent.
